# snake

the classic snake (arrow keys, grow, don't crash)

Category: games

![snake](../demos/snake.gif)

## Run it

```sh
cd snake && bb run   # from this demo (or jolt run, jolt -M:run)
bb snake             # from the repo root (or jolt -M:snake)
```

## About

raylib [games] example - the classic snake. Arrow keys steer; eat food to grow;
hitting a wall or yourself ends it (SPACE restarts). Grid + frame-tick movement,
all state threaded through the loop.
